Image 2 boardroom-left-v2.png is reference for Aki's face, short straight black bob, plain white short-sleeved T-shirt, red mechanic coveralls tied at waist. These are continuity/style references only; make a completely different camera composition.
Composition: intimate oblique tabletop insert looking from just behind Aki's side toward Celeste across the polished dark wood. Celeste's ivory-sleeved hand deliberately slides an open ivory envelope toward Aki. A single ordinary brass cylinder-lock key on a small plain ring rests ON the envelope, fully exposed, readable by silhouette, central in the upper-middle image. The key and envelope are the clear focal point. Celeste's composed adult face appears in the upper right midground; Aki's cautious adult face in three-quarter profile at the upper left edge, her hand held back near her own side rather than touching the offer. Strong triangular staging face / key / face. Contracts and a soft partial redevelopment map can sit off to the side. A rotary phone and 1986 Tokyo skyline can be understated background detail. The lower 25% is quiet table foreground for the game's dialogue overlay; key, hands and both faces must be entirely above that band.

Violet shadows, burnt amber sunset rim light, warm ivory highlights, dark reflective walnut. No motion blur.
Story/continuity: Aki is a 24-year-old Japanese adult woman, not a child. Celeste is a 32-year-old European adult woman, elegant and controlled. Preserve wardrobe/identities from references. No other major characters needed. A small existing SORA mark on Aki's sleeve is fine; avoid giant logos.
Constraints: landscape 16:9, single uninterrupted illustration, no panels, no collage, no captions, no subtitle box, no UI, no watermark, no prominent readable text. Key must unmistakably be offered by Celeste and NOT already accepted by Aki. Anatomically natural hands. This is a new scene, not a crop of the reference.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: full-frame 16:9 cutscene illustration for the 1986 narrative racing game SORA CARS, new asset boardroom-key-return-v3.png.
Primary request: Draw a NEW original composition showing Aki firmly returning the workshop key to Celeste across the boardroom table. This is Aki's decisive refusal: saving only her own garage is not worth controlling everyone else's lives. Aki is composed, resolved, neither shouting nor smiling. The returned key and the direction of her gesture must carry the scene.
Input images: Image 1 boardroom-left-v2.png is reference for Aki's short straight black bob, adult Japanese face, plain white T-shirt and red mechanic coveralls tied at waist. Image 2 boardroom-right-v2.png is reference for Celeste's champagne-blond shoulder-length curls, ivory 1980s business suit, white blouse, pearls and mature adult face. Image 3 boardroom-key-offer-v3.png establishes the exact ordinary brass cylinder-lock key on a small ring, cream paper envelope and sunset mood. References are continuity inputs only; compose an entirely NEW camera angle, not a crop or flipped copy.
Composition: Reverse angle from just beside Celeste's chair, looking toward Aki across the polished walnut table. Aki's upper body and resolute face dominate the left-center upper half; she leans slightly forward and stretches a naturally drawn open hand to push the same cream envelope with the brass key resting on it BACK toward Celeste, who is cropped as a recognizable ivory-sleeved shoulder and partial stern profile at the near right edge. Make Aki's action unmistakable: her fingers are behind the far edge of the envelope, pushing it away from herself; she does not keep, pocket or grasp the key. Place the envelope and prominent key near the center of the image around 55–60 percent height, all above the lower quarter. Her other hand rests by an old handwritten notebook on her own side, a subtle connection to her father's lesson. The table is longer diagonally, with empty space between the two women; show their disagreement through posture and stillness. Window sunset and 1986 Tokyo rooftops on the left, dark wood shelves on the rear wall, a modest land map and rotary telephone pushed aside. The lower 25% is quiet table surface, suitable behind a separate dialogue UI.
Style: match the references' refined 16-bit pixel-art clusters, crisp stepped linework, restrained dithering, rich visual-novel character rendering. Violet shadows, amber edge light, ivory fabrics, dark reflective walnut. No photorealism, soft-airbrushed faces or modern props.
Continuity: Aki is 24 and Celeste is 32, both clearly adult. Exact clothing and key continuity. Only those two characters need be present. Small existing SORA sleeve insignia is fine; no giant branding.
Constraints: single uninterrupted wide landscape 16:9 illustration. No collage or split panels. No subtitles, dialogue box, game UI, caption, watermark or prominent readable text. Aki's face, active hand, returned key and envelope must remain entirely within the upper 75 percent. This is the refusal and return AFTER the earlier offer, not another depiction of Celeste offering or Aki accepting.
